reviews.title: Easy to install
reviews.comment: Nice camera, no installation needed, Just plug it USB driver and choose HD pro pc webcam. Has a zoom feature, it adapts the lens to your distance to the camera. Image quality is fine, normal. Same as my laptop camera.
reviews.author: M. Baron

reviews.title: Really solid all-in-one option for meetings
reviews.comment: I bought this for work, primarily teams meetings on a windows 11 computer.  This is one of those devices that just works.  I have used it on windows 10 as well, with no issues.  What's cool about it is the built in mic is very good, so I don't have to have a separate microphone for people to hear me.  Sometime I do a screen recording, and the software I use shows the mic levels; It appears to do some adjusting because the levels are always good even if I don't talk loudly (honestly not sure if it's the camera or teams but it works great).  The video quality is great, no issues at all, and seems to be easy on the network as well.  The stand is easy to adjust no matter if you are setting it on your desk or on a monitor like mine is in the pictures.  The movement of stand and camera is stiff but smooth, very high quality feeling. I like that it lights up blue when the camera is active, and it's large enough to be easily noticeable.  We have quite a few of these at work now, and so far no issues with any of them.  It seems that Logitech is getting back to the quality that they used to be, and I like that.  They have been a go-to brand for many years, and have been known for great quality for a reasonable price.  I recommend this camera.
reviews.author: WRC

reviews.title: Logitech doesn’t disappoint!
reviews.comment:
This camera does not disappoint!
I’ve been a Logitech loyalist for years so I had no hesitation ordering the C920.
This model is small and seamless for setup w/an easy to use control dashboard.
Lighting adjustments are stellar and the auto functionality helps any novice produce great media.
The small size allows for superior grip anywhere you’re wanting to get that perfect angle.
5/5 great product!
reviews.author: Kate Jarvis

reviews.title: Solid performance, average low-light quality
reviews.comment:
The Logitech C920x is a reliable webcam that delivers solid 1080p video quality for everyday use. Image clarity is good, colors look natural, and autofocus works well for video calls, streaming, and basic recording. Setup is straightforward and it works immediately with most conferencing and streaming software. The built-in microphones are usable for casual calls and pick up voices clearly in a quiet room.
One downside is that performance in low-light conditions isn’t great. Without good lighting, the image can become grainy and lose detail, and the autofocus may hunt a bit. The microphones are also average at best and won’t replace a dedicated mic. Overall, it’s a dependable webcam that does what it’s known for, but proper lighting makes a big difference.
reviews.author: Christopher

reviews.title: A great camera that's plug-and-play
reviews.comment: It has been a long time since I had a piece of hardware that was absolutely plug-and-play. I set the camera on top of my laptop -- no need to attach it since I frequently use the laptop without a camera. When I plugged in the camera's USB and opened a zoom meeting, the new camera showed up instantly as an option. No need to install drivers or anything. The picture was very sharp, even in a dark office that just had a lamp. I absolutely love this little camera. And, with the Logitech brand, it was well worth the price.
reviews.author: Clembert
